items.name: Loon Cubikon NH 2025

venue.name: SNHU Dining Center Banquet Hall
venue.address: 2500 North River Road, Manchester, New Hampshire 03106
venue.details: There is ample parking on campus near the Banquet Hall.

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

items.name: Mahalo iā Maui 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Come join us for our annual WCA competition on the beautiful island of Maui!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.

items.name: Rubik's x TheCubicle CubingUSA All-Stars 2025
items.information:
We are excited to present CubingUSA All-Star Championship 2025, the 2025 US National Championship!

Please refer to the competition website for full details. We expect the qualification standards to be very competitive, so many interested competitors may not be able to participate.
